items.title: Deterministic Simulation Testing
items.author: Martin Fowler (martin@martinfowler.com)
items.description: Distributed systems are hard to test because partial failures overlap with live traffic and the same fault can produce different execution traces on different runs. items.title: Alloy: A Multi-Material Physics Engine for Robot Learning
items.author: Pranay Gupta, Deepanshu Rohilla
items.description: Robots handle much more than rigid objects: towels, cables, water, sand. The simulators used to train robots at scale are strongest on rigid bodies, and adding another material usually means a second engine and hand-written glue between the two.
